intro.cancelled: Hi {name}, your meeting with {host} has been cancelled.
intro.confirmed: Hi {name}, your meeting with {host} is confirmed. The invitation is attached, so you can add it to your calendar.
intro.guest: {booker} added you as a guest to a meeting with {host}. The invitation is attached.
intro.rescheduled: Hi {name}, your meeting with {host} has moved to a new time. The updated invitation is attached.

manage.cancelled: Was this a mistake, or would you like to book again? Reply to this email to reach {host}.
manage.guest: Questions? Reply to this email to reach {host}.
manage.withLinks: Need to make a change? You can {reschedule} or {cancel} this booking, or reply to this email to reach {host}.
manage.withoutLinks: Need to make a change? Reply to this email to reach {host}.

preview.cancelled: Your meeting with {host} on {date} has been cancelled.
preview.confirmed: Your meeting with {host} is confirmed for {date}.
preview.guest: {booker} added you to a meeting with {host} on {date}.
preview.rescheduled: Your meeting with {host} has moved to {date}.

calendar.footer: If you didn't expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.

intro.reschedule: {organizer} moved an event to a new time.
intro.restored: {organizer} put a cancelled event back on.

cancelled.body: The scheduled deletion of {workspace} has been cancelled. The workspace is active again.
cancelled.preview: The deletion of {workspace} has been cancelled.
cancelled.subject: Your WeldSuite workspace "{workspace}" is active again

scheduled.body: {workspace} has been suspended and will be permanently deleted on {date}. Access is disabled while it is suspended.

scheduled.subject: Your WeldSuite workspace "{workspace}" is scheduled for deletion

digest.footer: You're receiving this as a member of {workspace}.
digest.heading: Your tasks
digest.intro: Hi {name}, here's what's on your plate.
digest.preview: {overdue} overdue, {today} due today, {week} due this week.

enterprise.replyHint: Reply to this email to answer {contact} directly.
enterprise.subject: Enterprise inquiry: {company} ({size})

hrBank.byHr: The bank details {employer} pays your salary to were changed by HR, on {when}.
hrBank.byYou: You changed the bank details {employer} pays your salary to, on {when}.
hrBank.heading: Your bank details were changed
hrBank.notYou: If you didn't expect this, tell HR right away, before the next pay run.
hrBank.preview: The account your salary is paid to was changed.
hrBank.privacy: For your privacy, the account number is never sent by email.
hrBank.subject: Your bank details for payroll were changed

hrPayslip.body: Your payslip from {employer} for the payment on {date} is ready. You can read and download it in My HR.
hrPayslip.heading: Your payslip is ready
hrPayslip.preview: A new payslip from {employer} is ready to read.
hrPayslip.privacy: For your privacy, pay details are never sent by email.
hrPayslip.subject: Your payslip from {employer} is ready

meet.footer: If you didn't expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.
meet.intro: {organizer} invited you to a video meeting.
meet.noAccount: No account needed. The link opens the meeting in your browser.
meet.subject: {organizer} invited you to {title}

notifications.footer: You're receiving this because email notifications are on.

portal.expiresLink: The link and code expire in {minutes} minutes.
portal.footer: If you didn't try to sign in, you can ignore this email.
portal.useCode: Enter this code to sign in:

reachApproved.body: We approved {workspace} for WeldReach. Open it to add your sender details, a payment method for inboxes and your first domain.
reachApproved.heading: WeldReach is ready
reachApproved.limits: To start, you can connect up to {domains} domains and {mailboxes} inboxes, and send up to {sends} emails per day. Ask us if you need more.
reachApproved.preview: Your access to WeldReach was approved.
reachApproved.subject: WeldReach is ready for {workspace}
reachApproved.terms: Sending stays subject to the terms you accepted: business addresses only, your identity and an opt-out in every email, and opt-outs honoured for good. WeldSuite can pause sending if complaints or bounces get high.

reachRejected.again: If your situation changes, you can request access again from the app store. For questions, contact WeldSuite support.
reachRejected.body: We reviewed the WeldReach access request for {workspace} and could not approve it right now.
reachRejected.heading: We could not approve your request
reachRejected.preview: We could not approve your WeldReach access request.
reachRejected.subject: Your WeldReach access request for {workspace}

code.body: Enter this code on the signing page:
code.footer: If you didn't open a signing link just now, you can ignore this email.
code.kicker: Your code to open the document
code.subject: Your code to open "{title}": {code}

completed.attached: The signed document is attached, with a certificate of completion that records who signed and when.
completed.download: Download the signed document with its certificate of completion:
completed.footer: Keep this email or the PDF as your copy of the signed document.
completed.subject: "{title}" is signed

declined.body: The request is closed; nobody else can sign it. You can send a new request once you have sorted it out.
declined.subject: {name} declined to sign "{title}"

expired.body: Not everyone signed before the expiry date, so the request is closed and its links have stopped working. Send a new request if you still need the signatures.
expired.subject: "{title}" expired before everyone signed

request.expires: Sign before {date}. After that the link stops working.
request.footer: The link in this email is personal. Do not forward it: anyone with it can open and sign the document as you.
request.kicker: {sender} sent you a document to sign
request.reminderKicker: Reminder: {sender} is waiting for your signature
request.reminderPreview: A reminder to review and sign "{title}".
request.reminderSubject: Reminder: {sender} is waiting for you to sign "{title}"
request.subject: {sender} sent you "{title}" to sign

voided.body: You do not need to sign it any more, and the signing link has stopped working.
voided.subject: "{title}" was cancelled

workspaceInvite.body: You've been invited to {workspace} on WeldSuite as {role}. Accept the invitation to get started.
workspaceInvite.footer: This invitation was sent to {email}. If you didn't expect it, you can ignore this email.
